name: v0.36.0
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.36.0 -->

## What's Changed
### 🔧 Other Changes
* docs: add public APM adopters list by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3578
* fix(deps): place monorepo sibling children in deps tree and why by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3537
* fix(install): adopt unchanged committed skills on cold restore by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3564
* fix(git): pin core.symlinks=true so package hashes match across platforms by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3545
* feat(preflight): gate agent pushes and PRs on a local preflight receipt by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3580
* perf(deps): sweep raw CDN across marker probes before any anonymous Contents API call by @ShaoLOWu in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3348
* fix(install): resolve transitive deps from the manifest this run installs by @adityaanikam in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3571
* docs(producer): explain same-repository branch inheritance by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3591
* fix(ci): restore Windows post-merge suite after #3564 by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3592
* fix(claude): keep ${VAR} references in project .mcp.json by @Aaryan-Dadu in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3377
* fix(build): lower the Linux binary glibc floor to 2.28 by @eraow in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3553
* fix(deps): report the proxy archive rejection instead of a later HTTP 404 by @MohammedAlkindi in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3375
* Revert preflight-gate hook (#3580): local preflights overload multi-agent hosts by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3598
* fix(cursor): deploy user-scope instructions to ~/.cursor/rules by @yahavi in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2506
* fix(marketplace): pin plugins to a source sha by @abhishekacharya200 in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3534
* fix(hooks): type untyped flat command handlers for Codex by @Parth-Vasave in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3385
* feat(mcp): write native OpenCode 2 entries under mcp.servers by @RamsesJM in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3414
* feat(auth): auth-first opt-out and TLS config inheritance for github.com (#2545) by @rgarciapariente in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2999
* chore!: require Python 3.11 or newer (0.36.0) by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3589
* fix(lifecycle): keep pinned HTTP egress when only NO_PROXY is set by @bodapatisaikrishna in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3575
* docs(adopters): list EPAM as an adopter by @sergio-sisternes-epam in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3607
* docs(reference): add openclaw to experimental flags table by @MohammedAlkindi in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3366
* feat(cli): add export-patch command to export local spec edits as upstream patches by @edenfunf in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2162
* perf(compile): remove redundant work from instruction placement by @sekosen in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3379
* feat(compile): fire a pre-compile lifecycle event before reading sources by @Ryangr0 in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3596
* fix(mcp): name the searched registry and explain registry choice on a miss by @VedanthB in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2803
* refactor(tests): remove test smells in unit tests by @victtorqueiroz in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3451
* refactor(marketplace): extract ref propagation helper by @WilliamK112 in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/1992
* fix(install): omit author from auto-bootstrapped apm.yml by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3630
* fix(git): materialize package links from Git objects on every host by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3603
* docs(governance): roadmap pillars, epics and accepted-issue Horizon default by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3632
* test(install): assert one targeted install reconciles a dropped dependency by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3635
* feat(cli): derive apm mcp install forwarded options from apm install by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3633
* fix(hooks): anchor POSIX user-scope hook commands to $HOME by @Bronyal-lzx in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2944
* test(marketplace): cover registered ref install flow by @abhinavgautam01 in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/1994
* fix(registry): keep pre-releases out of stable semver ranges by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3601
* fix(dashboard): allowlist URL schemes in rendered markdown by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3637
* chore(devcontainer): retire the unpublished Dev Container Feature by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3642
* fix(audit): replay root .apm hooks that record no local files by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3600
* fix(deps): invalidate the manifest parse cache when apm.yml is rewritten, so re-downloads re-stamp by @McNultyyy in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2627
* fix(bundle): keep a directory source package out of the bundle path by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3604
* fix(update): adopt unchanged locked skills when receipts are missing by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3638
* feat(marketplace): add package category option by @WilliamK112 in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2637
* docs(governance): use validated filters for the Epics and Enterprise views by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3639
* chore(triage): migrate automation from theme/* to pillar/* labels by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3636
* refactor(cleanup): remove dead workflow package and deps aggregator by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3644
* [codex] Port universal applyTo to Cursor alwaysApply by @WilliamK112 in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2030
* feat(view): add read-only `apm view --file PATH` reverse provenance by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3608
* feat(autopilot): accept issues with a declared scope by @sergio-sisternes-epam in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3105
* fix(deps): agree with prune on bundled skills after repo-to-subdirectory switch by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3612
* fix(cli): derive consistency-checker surface from apm --help and fit root summaries by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3643
* fix(pack): use the apm.yml version in the bundled plugin.json by @abhishekacharya200 in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3408
* feat(init): add metadata flags for non-interactive project setup by @atulya-singh in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2231
* fix: match TLS failure hint to the selected trust mode by @aryansk in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2602
* fix(cache): clone SSH-declared non-GitHub deps over SSH in the persistent cache by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3640
* fix(codex): resolve package-relative links in converted agent instructions by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3611
* docs(agents): document per-harness model values workarounds by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3645
* fix(cache): retry incomplete promisor checkouts with credentials (#3071) by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3602
* feat(install): carry the source licence with subdirectory packages by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3646
* fix(cli): shorten apm view summary so root help is not truncated by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3651
* fix(git): pin core.eol=lf so text=auto package hashes match across platforms by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3599
* Add Grupo Universal to adopters by @gthen95 in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3647
* fix(codex): warn on Claude model ids in compiled Codex agents (supersedes #3481, closes #3477) by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3650
* feat(policy): walk GitLab subgroups for org policy discovery (#2753) by @rrazvd in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/2933
* fix(policy): judge the declared constraint, accept package release tags (supersedes #3381) by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3652
* fix(scope): make APM_HOME the single root for APM-owned user state by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3614
* feat(marketplace): load live local catalogs directly from apm.yml by @Nadeesha-D-Shalom in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3367
* fix(install): decode Git output as UTF-8 regardless of Windows locale by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3626
* fix(autopilot): align worker and PR body contracts by @sergio-sisternes-epam in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3419
* fix(install): name native target files a failed install leaves on disk by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3641
* feat(hooks)!: retire filename hook routing with safe migration by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3613
* feat(policy): host-qualified dependency allow/deny patterns by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3606
* fix(targets): honor CODEX_HOME for Codex user-scope writes (supersedes #3491, closes #3483) by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3653
* fix(git): check out out-of-cone link targets with Git's own checkout by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3673
* feat(marketplace): select a catalog in a repo with marketplace add --path by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3628
* fix(tests): use an OS-absolute APM_HOME in the scripts log path test by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3707
* fix(build): keep the host libgcc_s out of the Linux arm64 binary by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3708
* feat(marketplace): declare marketplaces in the user manifest, reconciled by apm install -g by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3610
* fix: 0.36.0 red-team regression sweep (export-patch, view --file, lockfile symlink, audit replay, targeted install, MCP cleanup) by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3672
* fix: 0.36.0 red-team round 2 (MCP config safety, user-file collisions, graph reconciliation, approvals, manifest corner cases) by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3709
* fix: 0.36.0 hardening of trust boundaries for credentials, deploy destinations, bundles and MCP consent by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3716
* fix(install): bundle installs for compile-only targets pass audit; skip Codex Markdown agents (#3705, #3706) by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3717
* test(lifecycle): validate command-line packages without the github.com API (#3649) by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3719
* fix(tests): restore release-gate lanes for 0.36.0 by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3723
* Update ADOPTERS.md by @pewpewpotato in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3755
* docs(adopters): add Supermodular by @ricardofiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3757
* chore: release v0.36.0 by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3759
* fix(tests): restore arm64 integration lanes for 0.36.0 by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3766
* chore: move internal agents to Claude Opus 5.5 by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3780
* ci(release): shard Linux integration, slim macOS, promote verified tags by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3771
* docs: teach your agent APM with the apm-guide package by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3776
* fix(tests): compare exact spellings in the case-sensitive fake reader by @danielmeppiel in https://github.com/microsoft/apm/pull/3787
